overview.en: Agra is home to three UNESCO World Heritage Sites — the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, and Fatehpur Sikri. Once the capital of the Mughal Empire, this city showcases some of the finest examples of Mughal architecture in the world. The Taj Mahal, built by Emperor Shah Jahan for his beloved wife Mumtaz, draws over 7 million visitors annually.
